title: Personalised news is currently broken because it prioritises engagement over understanding.
body:
For years, algorithms have fed us what they think we want to click on. The result is a cycle of outrage and shallow headlines that leave us feeling less informed, not more. We think the next phase of news needs to be different.

At Headlinne, we are building a roadmap that focuses on utility and depth. Instead of just showing you more of what you already read, we want to build tools that help you connect the dots between complex stories. The goal is to save you time while actually increasing your knowledge.

True personalisation isn't about profiling your habits to keep you scrolling longer. It is about respecting your time by filtering out the noise and delivering the information that matters to your life. We are moving away from the black box approach and toward a model where you have more control over what you see and why you see it.
cta: You can see how we are approaching this shift at HEADLINNE.com.
